name: Zhengduozhe Technology Inc.
summary: Zhengduozhe Technology Inc., operating as DAKOTA Life Sciences, is a biopharmaceutical enterprise dedicated to the acquisition, development, and commercialization of therapeutic agents. These pharmaceuticals are specifically engineered to prevent and treat severe medical conditions encountered in both clinical and community environments. A central focus for the company involves delivering solutions to individuals grappling with antimicrobial resistance and ensuring that necessary medications are available at reasonable prices. The firm was established in 1986 and is headquartered in Sioux Falls, South Dakota.
